title: AI-Learn：AI学习资源合集
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了AI学习资源，涵盖Python、数学、机器学习、深度学习、神经网络、LLM、RAG、提示词、Agent、AIOS及论文等内容，适合系统性学习人工智能。
summary_en: A GitHub repository collecting AI learning resources covering Python, mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, LLM, RAG, prompts, agents, AIOS, and papers for systematic AI study.
